title: MINER (BSC) — Flash Loan-Based Repeated skim Manipulation Analysis
root_cause: Attacker transferred MINER tokens to the pair and repeatedly called `skim()` 50 times to extract tokens in excess of reserves, then recovered WBNB via a final `swap()`
steps: → [3] Transfer MINER tokens to the pair contract
→ [4] Call skim() 50 times in a loop
→ [5] Transfer accumulated MINER to the pair and call swap()
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] DODO Flash Loan: Borrow 10 WBNB
  │
  ├─→ [2] PancakeSwap: Swap WBNB → MINER
  │
  ├─→ [3] Transfer MINER tokens to the pair contract
  │
  ├─→ [4] Call skim() 50 times in a loop
  │         └─ Each call extracts the balance-reserve difference in MINER
  │
  ├─→ [5] Transfer accumulated MINER to the pair and call swap()
  │         └─ Recover ~3.5 WBNB
  │
  └─→ [6] Repay DODO: 10 WBNB + fees
